notes: This is the supplied synthetic calculator configuration, not the 2400 kV physical machine.
Stock counts are per stage. Switching source dataset resistances exceed individual supplied components.
Stored-energy limits are derived mathematical values. Pulse ratings and mechanical fit are not supplied.

Switching.definition: Time to crest and half-value from waveform start; challenge convention

diagnostics.metric_extraction: Continuous modal peak and bracketed 30/90/50% root refinement; plot samples are not the final crossing metrics.
diagnostics.efficiency_convention: One voltage factor applied to erected initial voltage; includes assumed spark/connection loss.
diagnostics.limitations: No spark-gap dynamics, distributed capacitances, electromagnetic fields or pulse-rating model. Needs lab validation.

compliance.definition: 1.67 × rising 30–90%; half-value relative to virtual origin

ood.support_limit: Synthetic training uses only calculator-selected settings; arbitrary resistor or stage interventions are unsupported.

uncertainty.coverage_limit: Marginal under synthetic exchangeability; not joint, conditional-on-support, optimizer-selected or laboratory coverage.
uncertainty.method: Combined scenario envelopes include unsupported settings; no calibrated coverage guarantee

compliance.definition: 1.67 × rising 30–90%; half-value relative to virtual origin

raw_crest_charge_windows.scope: Raw-model charge ranges at this fixed resistor network, before stage/energy caps or local correction. Disjoint ranges cannot be repaired by charge adjustment alone.

model_agreement.scope: Agreement of two unvalidated models at the same hardware settings; not measured accuracy or laboratory compliance.
model_agreement.scenario_note: Finite independent parasitic scenarios, not a calibrated probability or proof over continuous ranges.

robustness.method: Latin hypercube; independent uniform parasitic ranges
robustness.note: Scenario fraction under stated assumptions, not probability of laboratory success. Intervals include finite sampled extremes; not a proof over continuous bounds.

explanation: 9 stages keep charging at 196.79 kV/stage, below the 200 kV limit.
Every resistor is counted: 45 total parts across front and tail networks.
Agreement search minimizes the worse waveform deviation across the workbook and independent circuit, using the same counted hardware. Score 0.806.
ML trust weight 0.00; out of distribution. No laboratory accuracy claim.

Rank 1 versus rank 2: both nominal model checks, then sampled agreement, then interval containment, then weighted cost (0.8061 versus 0.8085). This setup uses 45 parts versus 45; lower cost can trade waveform deviation against complexity and headroom.
Both nominal model checks and sampled agreement are ranked before interval containment and weighted cost. Neither model has laboratory validation.

waveform.note: Double-exponential curve fitted to predicted metrics; not an independently predicted waveform.

physics_waveform.note: Double-exponential curve fitted to predicted metrics; not an independently predicted waveform.

verification.scope: Fixed hardware checked after ranking using 128 separate-seed Latin-hypercube scenarios and 16 boundary corners. These checks do not select or reorder candidates. Finite simulation evidence only: not continuous-bound certification, independent model-accuracy testing or a laboratory success probability. Efficiency and hardware tolerances are held fixed; no statistical coverage claim.

warnings: Decision support only. Engineer verification and laboratory procedures remain required.
All trained models use supplied synthetic data. No measured laboratory validation has been completed.
Agreement search checks two unvalidated models, not measured accuracy. Uncertainty and support limits remain active.
Reference formulas assert crest = n × charge × efficiency. Curves reconstruct predicted metrics; the independent circuit cross-check can disagree.
Some hardware settings lie outside training support. Their correction is reduced or disabled and intervals have no calibrated coverage claim.

ranking_config.provenance: Engineering ranking choices for this PoC; not a calibrated laboratory utility function
ranking_order: Weighted objective using worse model deviations
ranking_config.search_note: Bounded enumeration and shortlist simulation; no global optimality guarantee
